inventory_rule: Standalone logistics operations do not change inventory or accounting. Optional linked documents are references only; authoritative business documents remain authoritative.
dependency_rule: Logistics Operations is independent. Vehicle Logistics is the reporting/control layer and depends on Logistics Operations.
security_rule: RLS enabled on logistics tables; direct anon/authenticated table access revoked; SECURITY DEFINER RPCs executable only by authenticated/service_role.
quantity_rule: Truck current load is starting load + completed pickups - completed deliveries - variances. Run completion requires primary and secondary quantities to reconcile within 0.001.
